context: Incident: rejudge/phase3_incident1_mirroring_2026-08-21.json. K2 mirroring was never executed; both slots duplicated one fixed label assignment per (question, transcript) unit. Realized main-grid assignment: 128 A-correct / 118 B-correct over the 246 (question, transcript) units; 63 of 82 questions carry both polarities across their transcripts; 19 are single-polarity.

steps.step: Verify polarity from RENDERED PROMPTS, never intended metadata: extract the realized A/B assignment for every (q, t, j, d, r) row from the archived composed prompts (call cache / result records), confirm the assignment matches across b0, sequential_b2, and batch_same_qa_b2 for every unit, and reproduce the banked H/P/R numbers exactly from the archive before anything else. Any mismatch or reproduction failure halts the reanalysis for review.
Collapse the duplicated K2 judgments to condition means at (q, t, j, d). Compute atomic H/P/R contrasts at that unit level, preserving H = P + R exactly.

For BOTH invalid rules (strict-INVALID-counts-wrong and common-support valid-only), report: (a) realized-schedule H/P/R (should equal the banked numbers under strict); (b) world-standardized A-polarity-only and B-polarity-only estimates; (c) the 50/50 standardized estimate (equal weight to the A and B strata within world); (d) the A-minus-B interaction; (e) the shift of each from the banked estimate.

Inference: common world-stratified question-cluster bootstrap draws shared across all quantities (B and seed pinned in this spec: B = 10000, seed = 20260821, same draw machinery as the frozen phase-2 engine). Additionally a within-question analysis restricted to the 63 questions having both polarities across transcripts, using direct within-question centering; treated as CORROBORATION only, since transcript content differs across polarities.
Prespecified diagnostics, none selected among afterward: judge-specific interaction contributions; leave-one-judge-out; leave-one-world-out; valid-only variants of all of the above.

Audit EVERY published phase-2 judgment result, not only H/P/R: the cap-protection interaction C under the same side-by-condition exposure, and D_clean (most exposed: debate averages three transcript polarities while the no-debate K3 comparator reuses the question's transcript-0 polarity, so even a raw side main effect may not cancel). Same standardization treatment where applicable.

decision_rule.survives_as_post_hoc_robust: the frozen 50/50-standardized H (strict rule) is positive, its 95% question-cluster CI excludes zero, AND the valid-only and within-question estimates agree in direction
decision_rule.withdraw_directional_headline: the primary standardized CI includes zero: report phase 2 as inconclusive for the mirrored target
decision_rule.retract: the standardized estimate is zero or negative
decision_rule.always: the erratum is mandatory regardless; any numerical mirrored-effect claim uses the corrected estimate; the original +3.94pp remains only as the realized-schedule estimate; P and R (and C, D_clean) require their own stability and are not rescued by a stable H; 'fully preregistered mirrored result' and 'all eligibility gates passed' are not restorable by this analysis
